reservation.title: Keep your next build within reach.
reservation.intro: Reserve an available model, track confirmed payments, and arrange delivery or pickup from one place.
reservation.rules: A confirmed initial payment of 50% starts a 15-day hold. Each completed additional 5% earns 10 more days, calculated from the original confirmation. Full payment stops expiry.
reservation.moneyNotice: An uploaded payment slip is not a confirmed payment. Staff must verify received funds. Expired holds remain allocated until staff review.
reservation.empty: Your collection starts with one model.
reservation.verified: I verified the completed bank transaction.
reservation.deliveryNotice: Staff confirmation stops expiry. Cash on delivery covers only the remaining balance. Pickup location and time must be arranged with staff.
reservation.cancelNotice: The deposit normally cannot be refunded after customer cancellation. Staff will record the final reconciliation; exceptions require documented shop fault.
reservation.evidenceNotice: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. Visible only to you and authorized staff. Uploading never confirms receipt of money.
reservation.acknowledgeForfeiture: I understand the deposit forfeiture policy for this cancellation.

policy.title: Commerce policy approvals
policy.intro: Resolve conflicting source rules before activating money workflows. Each approval creates a retained version with the responsible administrator and reason. Existing contracts keep their approved snapshot.
policy.confirmation: I approve these exact business terms and their activation for new transactions.
policy.inactive: No approved version. New financial transactions in this workflow remain inactive.

disclosures.reservation: Confirm that the hold uses the net merchandise quote, elapsed 24-hour days from the first verified payment, and additive authorized extensions.
disclosures.loyalty: Confirm the shared source reward table and one primary benefit per order. Refunded earnings are reversed using cumulative net merchandise, with debt carried when points were already spent. Select voucher expiry explicitly.
disclosures.pawn: The source prose states 0.03% per day while one formula says 0.3%. Select the approved rate, day counting, rounding, and grace period; no rate is selected automatically. Interest is capped at principal.
disclosures.marketplace: Select the approved fixed commission and settlement delay. The 10% guarantee is a separate liability, with shipping quoted per seller. Disputed funds remain frozen.
disclosures.buyback: Inspection precedes final customer acceptance and verified payout. Inbound COD is unsupported until an inspection-compatible arrangement is approved.

values.asset_handback: Interest continues until actual asset handback

loyalty.title: Build your collection. Grow your rewards.
loyalty.intro: Keep your member points, rewards and verified purchase history in one place.
loyalty.earning: Earn one point per 40,000 VND of eligible net merchandise on paid, delivered, undisputed purchases.
loyalty.benefits: Member benefits require an approved policy. Sale prices, tier benefits and points vouchers cannot be combined.
loyalty.signIn: Sign in to your collector club
loyalty.policyPending: Membership transactions await policy approval. Your existing history remains available.
loyalty.tierNote: Redeeming points keeps your tier. Invalidated purchases may reverse qualifying points; future earnings first recover point debt.
loyalty.noGifts: No stock gifts are currently configured.
loyalty.redemptionNote: Redemption deducts points immediately. Review the minimum spend, cap and expiry before redeeming.
loyalty.realGift: Subject to available SKU stock; delivery arranged after redemption.

loyalty.walletEmpty: Your redeemed rewards will appear here.
loyalty.historicalNote: Upload proof of an actual transaction. Staff verify its identity and recognized value; a reuploaded invoice cannot earn points twice.

loyalty.transactionVerified: I verified the original transaction and checked for duplicate awards.
loyalty.handoverVerified: I verified this gift was handed over or dispatched.
loyalty.moneyVerified: I verified this amount was paid back to the customer.

buyback.title: Give your next model a new home.
buyback.intro: Submit the exact model and its condition. Our staff review your photos, inspect the item, and ask you to accept a final quote before any payout.
buyback.ownershipNote: Your model remains yours until the final inspected quote is accepted and the shop has paid you.
buyback.codNote: Inbound COD requires a confirmed inspection and courier policy. Do not send a COD parcel before staff confirm the arrangement.
buyback.signIn: Sign in to submit or track a model
buyback.empty: Your model submissions will appear here.
buyback.handoverVerified: I verified the physical model was received or handed back.
buyback.photoNote: Upload 3–12 distinct views: front, back, sides, fragile details, box, accessories and defects. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each. Original evidence is visible only to you and authorized staff.
buyback.preliminaryNote: Photo-based estimate; physical inspection can change this amount.
buyback.finalNote: This quote is not a payment receipt. Only your acceptance of the current version authorizes payout.
buyback.returnPending: Awaiting customer acceptance of return terms.
buyback.acceptNote: Review the final amount and all revised condition details. Accepting this version records your agreement; ownership transfers only after verified payout.
buyback.acceptReturn: Accept these return and cost terms
buyback.payoutNote: Record the exact accepted amount only after verifying the actual outgoing payment.
buyback.moneyVerified: I verified that this exact amount was actually paid to the customer.
buyback.returnNote: State the actual delivery method, address arrangement and responsibility for return shipping costs. The customer must accept these terms before handback.
buyback.intakeNote: Create a fresh archived preowned draft with zero stock, the same model code and at least three distinct shop-uploaded actual-item photos. Reconcile its disclosed condition with the inspection before activation.
buyback.actualPhotosVerified: I verified these are shop photographs of this exact inspected model and its disclosed condition.

events.payout: Actual payout and ownership transfer verified

buyback.historyDetails: View the recorded quote and decision

pawn.title: Keep your collection. Unlock its value.
pawn.intro: Request an appraisal for your actual model. Review the loan, interest and contract conditions before signing. Staff confirm physical custody and actual disbursement separately.
pawn.custodyNote: Pledged models stay in private custody and are excluded from sellable stock.
pawn.capNote: Simple interest is capped at principal. Reaching the cap never transfers ownership or authorizes disposal; only the accepted contract and a verified authorized decision can do that.
pawn.signIn: Sign in to request or track a pawn contract
pawn.empty: Your pawn requests and contracts will appear here.
pawn.details: Exact agreement, inspection or decision details
pawn.handoverVerified: I verified the actual physical asset handover.
pawn.forecast: Estimated interest for the agreed term
pawn.startNote: Interest and the agreed term start at actual verified disbursement. Early redemption uses actual chargeable days under the stated policy.
pawn.disposalAgreed: Disposal is permitted only after the agreed overdue grace period and verified contractual conditions.
pawn.disposalNotAgreed: These terms do not authorize asset disposal.
pawn.custodyReference: Actual asset custody tag / receipt reference
pawn.termsAccepted: I accept this exact principal, interest policy, term and contract conditions.
pawn.disposalTermsAccepted: I explicitly accept the stated contractual disposal conditions and grace period.
pawn.signedContractNote: Arrange signatures with staff, then upload private JPG, PNG or WebP scans of the actual current signed agreement (up to 10 MB per image). Staff must verify both signatures; this button does not create an electronic signature.
pawn.proposedDueAt: Requested new due date (your local time)
pawn.extensionNote: A request does not extend the contract automatically. The original interest policy and cap remain unchanged.
pawn.quoteNote: A confirmed policy is required. Changing terms before disbursement requires new customer acceptance and a new verified signed agreement.
pawn.signatureVerified: I verified both parties signed this exact current agreement and the scans match these terms.
pawn.conditionMatches: I verified the exact asset and its condition match the signed agreement. Any mismatch requires revised terms and consent before disbursement.
pawn.moneyVerified: I verified this exact bank payment was actually executed in the indicated direction.
pawn.handbackNote: Payment and asset handback are separate. For an accrual-until-handback agreement, settle any additional approved interest first.
pawn.eligibilityVerified: I verified the signed contract, overdue date, elapsed grace period and all pending extension decisions.
pawn.disposalAuthorized: I am authorized to record this documented contractual disposal; this is not an automatic interest-cap action.

status.in_custody: Asset in custody, no disbursement yet

pawn.overdueReminder: Contract #{id} passed its due date {date}. Review repayment or request an extension.
pawn.historyDetails: View the recorded agreement and decision
pawn.disposalAccountingNote: Disposal does not settle the loan automatically. Staff must reconcile debt, sale proceeds and any customer balance under an approved agreement.

partnerGuarantee.title: Seller guarantee
partnerGuarantee.intro: A guarantee holds your own funds separately from sales revenue and commission. Content approval and a transfer do not publish the listing.
partnerGuarantee.policyPending: Guarantee transactions await explicit approval of marketplace terms and VND rounding.
partnerGuarantee.consent: I accept this exact guarantee amount, rounding and refund terms for the reviewed listing.
partnerGuarantee.refundTerms: Your guarantee returns in full on a successful sale or compliant withdrawal with no outstanding obligations. Any deduction requires separate evidenced findings.
partnerGuarantee.empty: Content approval is required before guarantee terms can be accepted.
partnerGuarantee.unusedRefundOnly: This action returns the full guarantee for a hidden listing that has never been published or purchased. Sold or disputed listings require settlement reconciliation.
partnerGuarantee.moneyVerified: I verified this completed bank transaction and the exact amount.
partnerGuarantee.bankVerified: I verified the accepted account holder and unchanged bank account.

partnerBank.title: Payout account and account closure
partnerBank.intro: Bank changes require private proof and staff verification. Resolve accepted guarantees and existing sales first. New selling is paused during bank review; historical transactions remain unchanged.
partnerBank.consent: I request this change and understand that open obligations must be reconciled and publication requires a new review.
